mistral.price_basis: Conservative original sticker rates; current launch discount not assumed.

calibration.failure_policy: Do not dispatch that provider's study. Preserve its full planned denominator.

study.repeat_selection: One lowest opaque SHA-256 ID per renderer/cue/information/view/label stratum; no answer or score selection.
study.unit: One response per stateless request; no pairwise winner, no AB/BA position claim.
study.blinding: Canonical question and visible facts only; hide model names, conditions, cue/envelope, gold and prior scores. Original renderings remain separately retained.
study.unknown_policy: Keep unclear, invalid, incomplete, refusal and missing separate; no majority gold or repair.

credential_authority: User explicitly authorized existing zshrc keys in this thread. No secret copy or new key.
cost_authority: User removed the dollar ceiling for this judge workflow; finite grid and token caps remain. Invoice UNKNOWN.
attempt_policy: Exclusive durable reservation before dispatch; no retransmission, including ambiguous or HTTP failures. Stop new requests after transport/HTTP failure, preserve in-flight outcomes and undispatched rows.
model_identity_ceiling: Requested and returned IDs only. Remote weights cannot be proven immutable; family, budget, and settings differ together.
